Explicitly identifies cached production WebP initialization and implements an encoderPromise cache around factory loading and readiness.
Recovers AMD module/require/exports, readiness, module URI and locateFile asset binding; independent adapter binds the selected original codec WASM without loading the production pipeline.

Actual encode call receives RGBA typed array, dimensions and complete unchanged numeric WebP options; codec validation is preserved rather than reduced to a quality-only wrapper.

Correct alpha/lossless/near_lossless/sharp-YUV field interface is enumerated and forwarded; production UI lossless-preset and near-lossless control conversions are not mapped.
Correct falsy-codec-result to Encoding-error boundary is identified and implemented, with retained actual invalid-quality rejection evidence.

Correct last-extension replacement/append behavior is described and implemented for the bounded workflow, with actual named output evidence; general filename edge-case parity is not inferred.

Specific malformed-image/codec rejection evidence, unsupported-format/HQX exclusions, post-decode allocation limit, watchdog boundary and untested runtime/color/large-input cases remain explicit.
